headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW6
deck: Lawro goes against the favourites twice, backing Cowthenbeef over The Truffle Pigs and GlengarryHearts over Bayern Bru.
body: Five ties, ten managers, and not a point between any of them. Twenty-two years of predictions on the BBC, and now I'm marked by ten lads in a draft league.

ties.line:
its_ohi look the part and rarely play it. B.Fernandes has gone two games without a goal or an assist for them, and Tottenham are the visitors at Manchester United. Brobbey of its_ohi is injured. Gibbs-White, for If anyone can, Bannan can, has a gentle trip to Crystal Palace, the sort of easy game that gets wasted every week.

The team name says anyone can. Not this week. its_ohi, and I won't enjoy saying it.

I've never trusted The Raccoons, but they do have Haaland, who has scored in each of his last two. Gonzalo is off to Ipswich Town, and that back line is softer than a wet loaf. domeitalycoach have answered by bringing in five off the waiver list this week. Five. Somebody else's cast-offs, every one of them.

The Raccoons.

Top of the table, AtleticoTimHortons, and nothing top of the table in October ever stays there. Groß has found the net in both his last games for them, which is more than most. Semenyo is a slight doubt. Hazza Maguazza's Redempshazza have Tarkowski up against Hull City, a weak attack. A defender against that lot isn't defending, it's standing about. Football was better when a clean sheet had to be earned.

AtleticoTimHortons, with Groß doing the damage.

Cowthenbeef are third and steadier than they've any right to be. The Truffle Pigs are the favourites, and I'm going against them. Cowthenbeef have Bassey facing Ipswich Town, a toothless lot up front, and Verbruggen away at Sunderland. The Truffle Pigs have both of theirs off to Sunderland, and nobody gets the Ipswich trip. I played centre-half, and I'd take that trip any day. Rice is a doubt for The Truffle Pigs, with an injury nobody will name. Unspecified, they call it.

Cowthenbeef, and Bassey will see to it.

Bayern Bru sit second, and how did that happen? The favourites, apparently, and I'm siding with GlengarryHearts instead. Isak and Virgil, for GlengarryHearts, are proper footballers who do the simple things well. Manchester City come to Liverpool, and neither of them will be bothered. I'll still have to sit through City passing it sideways for an hour.

GlengarryHearts, who know what they're doing.
